representativeSnapshot.kind: Supabase project with promoter Phases 1-7 applied

rowCountQueries: event promoter program, membership, application, attribution, and ledger counts by event
ticket-sale attribution counts by ticket type and source
tour-events associated with the target event and the organizer's manageable event subset
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Creates read-only event analytics functions only. No applications, memberships, attribution records, ledger entries, or payout allocations are changed.

execution.resumeStrategy: The read-only functions are replaceable and idempotent. No data backfill or mutation occurs.
execution.idempotency: The dashboard and CSV contain only derived values. The event parameter is checked against the authenticated organizer inside the private function before any financial row is read.

quarantine.strategy: Disable event_promoter_program_enabled to hide the surface and forward-fix the read function; no financial history needs rollback.

constraints: Organizer access is enforced both by the admin route and private.can_manage_event_promoter_program in the database function
CSV uses the same event-scoped RPC result and excludes payment references, tracking tokens, and buyer data
Tour aggregation includes only stops for which the calling organizer passes the event-management predicate
Ticket-type eligible revenue is joined to pre-aggregated financial rows to prevent multiple ledger entries from inflating attribution totals
indexes: Uses existing event/program status, membership, attribution order, ledger membership/program/originating-entry, touchpoint, ticket-type, and tour-events indexes
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Compare per-event and ticket-type figures against raw ticket_sale_attributions and promoter_commission_ledger. Test organizer A allowed, organizer B denied, a non-admin denied, a multi-currency ledger, a reversal, and a shared tour where only accessible stops contribute.

recovery.rollback: Disable event_promoter_program_enabled. No data rows are created or changed.
recovery.forwardFix: Use an additive function replacement after retaining the organizer event-scope predicate and ledger-derived financial contract.

queries: public.get_event_promoter_organizer_analytics has authenticated execute only and private helper is not exposed
unmanaged event and non-admin calls fail with 42501/403
promoter rankings, source performance, ticket-type performance, and CSV totals reconcile with immutable ledger and attribution rows
tour aggregate excludes stops without organizer event access
